cast_on_you.after: QA337 temporary melee aid is active.

spell_fades.after: QA337 temporary melee aid has ended.

retained_applied_evidence.receipt_location: Operator-private evidence; identified by receipt_id and exact receipt_sha256.

online_native_mode.tester_native_receipt: Coordinator must pin actual tester receipt path and SHA before either transition; a proposal/template is insufficient.
online_native_mode.native_evidence: Actual current native attack-stop and exact39999 buff absence required; no stale cached/manual assertion substitutes.
online_native_mode.root_authorization: Exact published commit, SQL SHA, direction, receipt pin and one application GO required.

clean_logged_out_mode.native_pre_camp_receipt: Exact owner-pinned actual337 attack-off and39999-absent native observation before normal camp; retain its real observation time, never relabel it fresh/current native.
clean_logged_out_mode.normal_camp_chain: Pin tester normal-camp and owned client termination evidence; no intervening39999 recast/restore/relogin after the absence observation. Unexpected or ambiguous chain stops this mode.
clean_logged_out_mode.current_quiescence: Pin current owner evidence client remains closed, input custody inactive, and affected server remains stopped. Hold these states through DB transition and coordinated cache/client installation.

fresh_persisted_absence.connection: Authoritative character/runtime database, fresh read-only connection immediately before the one authorized UPDATE.
fresh_persisted_absence.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM character_buffs WHERE character_id=337 AND spell_id=39999
fresh_persisted_absence.evidence: Record exact query, schema/server identity, UTC time and zero count in private application receipt. This is persisted absence, not fresh native observation.
fresh_persisted_absence.failure: Any nonzero count, unavailable/mismatched schema, identity uncertainty or intervening client/server start stops; no automatic buff deletion/fade/launch/repair.

clean_logged_out_mode.no_new_native_episode: No old-server/client launch to manufacture a fresh absence observation. Existing earned state and prior episode remain untouched.
clean_logged_out_mode.same_safety_property: Known actual native absence before clean save/exit, fresh absence in the persisted buff store used at login, and no live process able to recast or retain an active instance during replacement.
clean_logged_out_mode.root_authorization: Exact published revised contract pin, original SQL SHA/direction, all evidence receipt pins and one explicit coordinator application GO still required.

required_external_gates.mode_switch: Select and record one mode explicitly; do not silently waive original online-current-native requirement.

execution_contract.expected_full_current_row: Exact retained2M before apply; exact100k before inverse.
execution_contract.CLI_delimiter_wrapper: MariaDB client handles DELIMITER, or operator strips only wrappers and invokes complete BEGIN NOT ATOMIC block once.
execution_contract.string_guards: BINARY comparison against UTF8 byte hex literals.
execution_contract.independent_postcommit_readback: New independent connection SELECT * FROM spells_new WHERE id=39999; compare all237 fields against exact target JSON, save receipt.
execution_contract.uncertain_execution: STOP; report and reconcile read-only. Never automatically retry or apply inverse.

scope_limits.cache_and_client_freshness: Build/client owners in one combined coordinator window; SQL/readback does not prove cached/native profile.

source_basis_for_logged_out_mode.zone/zonedb.cpp: SaveBuffs writes character_buffs for CharacterID; LoadBuffs restores that table filtered by character_id.
source_basis_for_logged_out_mode.common/repositories/base/base_character_: Columns character_id and spell_id identify the bounded saved buff check.
